notes: Designing your own house, decorating it, shopping and dressing up is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, and the housing model is the expensive decision here: the author confirmed every player gets their own empty plot, so this is settlement-buildable and the Home Builder preset rather than the more common claimable model. Decorating the inside of your house and buying from shops both mean players go indoors, so building-interior stands alongside the buildable plots and the route is P3. Decided without a user: dressing up is avatar customization at the clothing shops rather than a judged runway, so no stage-runway shape and no second genre — the genre file is clear that a dress-up game with a settlement is not the Dress Up case. The author's count of 8 plots is recorded here since the scale band cannot hold an exact figure, and the preset's vehicle road network is kept as the grid the plots and shops sit on even though no cars were named.
